description: Class representing an icon set conditional formatting rule.

GetAppliesTo.description: Returns the range of cells to which the current conditional formatting rule applies.

returns.description: The range of cells affected by the current condition, or null if no range is set.

GetDateOperator.description: Returns the date operator for time period conditions.

returns.description: The time period operator that defines how the date condition is evaluated,or null if the rule is not date-based.

GetFillColor.description: Returns the background color for the format condition. Returns 'No Fill' when the background color of the format condition is null.

returns.description: The background color applied by the format condition, or 'No Fill' if none is set.

GetFont.description: Returns the font applied by the current format condition.

returns.description: An ApiFont object representing the font applied by the format condition, or null if no font is defined.

GetFormula.description: Returns the formula associated with the icon set condition.

returns.description: The formula string, or empty string if no formula is set.

GetFormula1.description: Returns the first formula used by the current conditional formatting rule.

returns.description: The first formula.

GetFormula2.description: Returns the second formula used by the current conditional formatting rule.

returns.description: The second formula.

GetIconCriteria.description: Returns a collection of icon criteria that represent the threshold values and icons for the icon set conditional formatting rule.

returns.description: A collection of icon criteria objects, or null if the rule is not an icon set type.

GetIconSet.description: Returns the icon set type used in the conditional formatting rule.

returns.description: The icon set type, or null if not applicable.

GetNumberFormat.description: Returns the number format applied to a cell when the conditional formatting rule evaluates to true.

returns.description: The number format.
The format condition operator.

GetPTCondition.description: Returns the pivot table condition object.

returns.description: The pivot table condition object.

GetParent.description: Returns the parent range object of the current format condition.

returns.description: The parent range object.

GetPercentileValues.description: Returns whether the thresholds for the icon set conditional format are determined by using percentiles.

returns.description: True if all thresholds are set to percentile, false otherwise.

GetPriority.description: Returns the priority value of the conditional formatting rule.

returns.description: The priority value of the conditional formatting rule.

GetReverseOrder.description: Returns whether the icon order in the icon set rule is reversed.

returns.description: True if the icon order is reversed, false otherwise, or null if not applicable.

GetScopeType.description: Returns the scope type of the conditional formatting rule.

returns.description: Returns "xlSelectionScope" for normal ranges, "xlDataFieldScope" for entire worksheet, "xlFieldsScope" for pivot tables.

GetShowIconOnly.description: Returns whether only icons are displayed in the icon set rule (without cell values).

returns.description: True if only icons are shown, false if values are also shown, or null if not applicable.

GetStopIfTrue.description: Returns whether the editor will stop evaluating additional formatting rules if this rule evaluates to true.

GetText.description: Returns the text value used in text-based conditional formatting rules.

returns.description: The text value used in text-based conditional formatting rules.

GetTextOperator.description: Returns the text operator for text-based conditional formatting rules.

returns.description: The operator defining how the text comparison is performed,or null if the rule is not text-based.

GetType.description: Returns the type of the icon set conditional formatting rule.

returns.description: The type of the icon set conditional formatting rule.

Modify.description: Modifies the current format condition with the specified parameters.

params.description: The format condition type.
params.name: Type

params.description: The format condition operator.
params.name: Operator

params.description: The first formula.
params.name: Formula1

params.description: The second formula.
params.name: Formula2

returns.description: The modified format condition, or null if the rule does not exist.

Modify.signature: Modify(Type?: XlFormatConditionType, Operator?: XlFormatConditionOperator, Formula1?: string | number | ApiRange, Formula2?: string | number | ApiRange): ApiFormatCondition | null

ModifyAppliesToRange.description: Sets the cell range to which the current conditional formatting rule applies.

params.description: The range to which the current conditional formatting rule will be applied.
params.name: Range

SetBorders.description: Sets the border style for the conditional formatting rule.

params.description: Specifies the cell border position.
params.name: bordersIndex

params.description: Specifies the line style used to form the cell border.
params.name: lineStyle

params.description: The color object which specifies the color to be set to the cell border.
params.name: oColor

SetBorders.signature: SetBorders(bordersIndex: BordersIndex, lineStyle: LineStyle, oColor: ApiColor): void

SetDateOperator.description: Sets the date operator for time period conditions.

params.description: The date operator for time period conditions.
params.name: DateOperator

SetFillColor.description:
Sets the background color to the format condition with the previously created color object.
Sets 'No Fill' when previously created color object is null.

params.description: The color object that specifies the background color for the format condition.
params.name: oColor

SetFirstPriority.description: Sets the priority value for the current conditional formatting rule to "1" so that it will be evaluated before all other rules on the worksheet.

SetIconSet.description: Sets the icon set type for the conditional formatting rule.

params.description: The icon set type to apply.
params.name: iconSet

returns.description: True if the icon set was successfully set, false otherwise.

SetLastPriority.description: Sets the evaluation order for the current conditional formatting rule so it is evaluated after all other rules on the worksheet.

SetNumberFormat.description: Sets the number format applied to a cell when the conditional formatting rule evaluates to true.

params.description: The number format code (e.g., "General", "#,##0.00", etc.)
params.name: NumberFormat

SetPercentileValues.description: Specifies whether the thresholds for the icon set conditional format are determined by using percentiles.

params.description: True to set all thresholds to percentile, false otherwise.
params.name: percentileValues

returns.description: True if the percentile values were successfully set, false otherwise.

SetPriority.description: Sets the priority value of the conditional formatting rule.

params.description: The priority value (1-based).
params.name: Priority

SetReverseOrder.description: Specifies whether the icon order in the icon set rule is reversed.

params.description: True to reverse the icon order, false otherwise.
params.name: reverse

returns.description: True if the setting was successfully applied, false otherwise.

SetScopeType.description: Sets the scope type for the conditional formatting rule.

params.description: The scope type: "xlSelectionScope", "xlDataFieldScope", or "xlFieldsScope".
params.name: ScopeType

SetShowIconOnly.description: Specifies whether to display only icons in the icon set rule (without cell values).

params.description: True to show only icons, false to show both icons and values.
params.name: showIconOnly

returns.description: True if the setting was successfully applied, false otherwise.

SetStopIfTrue.description: Sets whether the editor will stop evaluating additional formatting rules if this rule evaluates to true.

params.description: True to stop evaluating additional rules.
params.name: StopIfTrue

SetText.description: Sets the text value used in text-based conditional formatting rules.

params.description: The text value to compare against.
params.name: Text

SetTextOperator.description: Sets the text operator for text-based conditional formatting rules.

params.description: The text operator: "xlContains", "xlDoesNotContain", "xlBeginsWith", "xlEndsWith".
params.name: TextOperator
